I just finished my first game of Tactics and really enjoyed it, but a few rules need some clerification.

1. Hazard tiles

Do hazard tiles affect structures, example the pylons in Blade 3, if a hazard tile, such as Zero's impaling structors card and they are placed on the pylons, do the pylons get hit and if so when, at the end of blades turn?

Also How long do player created hazards last?

2. Player slows

How long do player institutied slows last, the way I played it was it affected 1 movment and moved on.

3. Radius effects

How do aoe raduis work, do they have to have a line of sight of the target from the origin point?

4. Blade scenario 2

How do you end blade 2? The objective is to set  up as many structors as possible, but does it move on if all structors die or if he dies?

posts.name: Ronway
posts.cooked:
1a. No, Pylons do not have a turn, so are not able to end their turn on a hazard space, thus immune.

1b. Player created hazards last until the card that created is removed.

2. Just the 1 movement, the character goes back to normal after that.

3.Yes they need LoS, unless otherwise stated.

4. In the setup, the last sentence. It has you make a pile of 5 Scenario Markers, at the end of every round you remove 1. After the last 1 is removed, the match ends.

posts.name: Ronway
posts.cooked:
All reach does is allow you to check as if the target is closer. If a target is at range 3, then AZ's then dice rolling 1+ will not be removed for not making range. If the target is at range 4, then rolls of 2+ will not be removed for not making range.

It does not increase the radius of Thermal Shockwave.
